items.example: He's been so smug since he got promoted.
items.exampleTr: Terfi aldığından beri öyle bir kendini beğenmiş ki.
items.simple: Too pleased with yourself, in an annoying way.
dialogue: A: Did you see his face when he won?
B: Yeah, he looked so smug.
items.note: Olumsuz; 'smug look/smile' çok yaygın.

items.example: She was a bit miffed that nobody asked her opinion.
items.exampleTr: Kimsenin fikrini sormamasına biraz bozuldu.
items.simple: A little bit angry or hurt, not very much.
dialogue: A: Is Jo okay?
B: She's a bit miffed we didn't invite her.
items.note: Gündelik, özellikle İngiliz İngilizcesi; küçük kırgınlıklar için.

items.example: I was really peeved when they cancelled at the last minute.
items.exampleTr: Son dakikada iptal edince gerçekten gıcık oldum.
items.simple: Annoyed because someone did something unfair or silly.
dialogue: A: Why are you peeved?
B: Someone ate my lunch from the fridge again.
items.note: 'pet peeve' = en gıcık olduğun şey.

items.example: The near miss on the motorway left me a bit rattled.
items.exampleTr: Otoyolda kıl payı atlattığımız kaza beni biraz sarstı.
items.simple: Shaken and nervous after something scary or surprising.
dialogue: A: You look pale. What happened?
B: Some guy shouted at me on the bus. I'm a bit rattled.
items.note: 'Don't let him rattle you' = seni sarsmasına izin verme.

items.example: I get flustered when people watch me cook.
items.exampleTr: İnsanlar beni yemek yaparken izleyince telaşlanıyorum.
items.simple: Nervous and confused because you are in a hurry or watched.
dialogue: A: Why did you forget your lines?
B: The director walked in and I got flustered.
items.note: Utanç ve aceleyle karışık telaş için.

items.example: He looked crestfallen when she said no.
items.exampleTr: Kız hayır deyince yüzü düştü.
items.simple: Very sad because you hoped for something and didn't get it.
dialogue: A: How did Tim take the news?
B: He was crestfallen. He really wanted that job.
items.note: Ani hayal kırıklığının yüze yansıması.

items.example: The kids were giddy with excitement on Christmas Eve.
items.exampleTr: Çocukların Noel arifesinde heyecandan içi içine sığmıyordu.
items.simple: So happy and excited that you feel a little silly.
dialogue: A: You're smiling like a teenager.
B: I know! I feel giddy since he called.
items.note: Hem heyecan hem baş dönmesi anlamında.

items.example: He's completely smitten with his new girlfriend.
items.exampleTr: Yeni kız arkadaşına resmen abayı yakmış.
items.simple: Suddenly in love, or liking someone very, very much.
dialogue: A: Your brother can't stop talking about Ayşe.
B: He's totally smitten.
items.note: Genelde 'smitten with someone'; bebek ve evcil hayvan için de.

items.example: I was mortified when my phone rang during the funeral.
items.exampleTr: Cenazede telefonum çalınca utançtan yerin dibine girdim.
items.simple: So embarrassed that you want to hide forever.
dialogue: A: You sent the joke to your boss instead of your friend?
B: Yes. I'm mortified.
items.note: 'embarrassed'ın çok daha güçlüsü.

items.tr: huysuz, diken diken, hemen savunmaya geçen
items.example: She gets a bit prickly if you ask about her ex.
items.exampleTr: Eski sevgilisini sorarsan biraz diken diken oluyor.
items.simple: Easily annoyed and quick to get defensive.
dialogue: A: Why did he snap at me?
B: He's always prickly before his coffee.
items.note: Hem kişi hem konu için: 'a prickly subject'.

items.example: He was very cagey about where he'd been all night.
items.exampleTr: Bütün gece nerede olduğu konusunda çok ketumdu.
items.simple: Not wanting to tell you things, a bit secretive.
dialogue: A: Did she tell you why she's leaving?
B: No, she was really cagey about it.
items.note: Bir şey saklıyormuş gibi davranan biri için.

items.example: I've felt a bit listless since the holidays ended.
items.exampleTr: Tatil bittiğinden beri kendimi biraz isteksiz hissediyorum.
items.simple: No energy, and not interested in doing anything.
dialogue: A: You've been on the sofa all day.
B: I know. I just feel listless.
items.note: Hem yorgunluk hem de motivasyonsuzluk için.

items.example: I was nonplussed when he suddenly started crying.
items.exampleTr: Birden ağlamaya başlayınca afalladım.
items.simple: So surprised and confused that you don't know what to do.
dialogue: A: What did you say when she proposed?
B: Nothing! I was totally nonplussed.
items.note: Dikkat: Amerikancada bazen 'umursamaz' anlamında da kullanılır.

items.example: Everyone raved about the film, but I was underwhelmed.
items.exampleTr: Herkes filme bayıldı ama ben hiç etkilenmedim.
items.simple: You expected something great, but it was just okay.
dialogue: A: So, how was that famous burger place?
B: Honestly? I was a bit underwhelmed.
items.note: 'overwhelmed'ın esprili karşıtı; gündelik ve yaygın.

items.tr: ünlü birini görünce büyülenmiş, dili tutulmuş
items.example: I met my favourite singer and got completely starstruck.
items.exampleTr: En sevdiğim şarkıcıyla tanıştım, dilim tutuldu.
items.simple: So excited to meet a famous person that you can't speak.
dialogue: A: Did you ask for a selfie?
B: No, I was too starstruck to say a word.
items.note: Ünlülerle karşılaşınca yaşanan heyecan.

items.example: She seemed a bit put out that we started without her.
items.exampleTr: Onsuz başladığımıza biraz bozulmuş gibiydi.
items.simple: A little upset because you were not treated nicely.
dialogue: A: Is Dad annoyed we didn't call?
B: He's a bit put out, but he'll get over it.
items.note: İngilizce'de çok yaygın, kibar bir 'gücenmek'.

items.example: I'm at a loose end this Saturday if you fancy a drink.
items.exampleTr: Bu cumartesi boştayım, bir şey içmek istersen.
items.simple: You have nothing to do and feel a bit bored.
dialogue: A: What are you doing tonight?
B: Nothing, I'm at a loose end. Why?
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikanca 'at loose ends'.

items.example: I've been out of sorts all week, I think I'm coming down with something.
items.exampleTr: Bütün hafta keyifsizdim, sanırım hasta oluyorum.
items.simple: You feel a bit ill or a bit sad, not like yourself.
dialogue: A: You're quiet today.
B: Sorry, I'm a bit out of sorts.
items.note: Hafif hastalık ya da hafif moral bozukluğu için.

items.example: I was beside myself with worry when he didn't come home.
items.exampleTr: Eve gelmeyince endişeden kendimde değildim.
items.simple: A feeling is so strong that you can't control yourself.
dialogue: A: Were you scared when the kids got lost?
B: I was beside myself.
items.note: Genelde 'beside yourself with worry/rage/joy'.

items.en: at the end of my tether
items.example: The baby hasn't slept for three nights. I'm at the end of my tether.
items.exampleTr: Bebek üç gecedir uyumadı. Sabrımın sonuna geldim.
items.simple: You are so tired and stressed you can't take any more.
dialogue: A: Are the builders still making noise?
B: Every morning at seven. I'm at the end of my tether.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikanca 'at the end of my rope'.

items.example: The kids are chomping at the bit to open their presents.
items.exampleTr: Çocuklar hediyelerini açmak için sabırsızlanıyor.
items.simple: So eager to start that you can't wait.
dialogue: A: Is the new guy ready to start?
B: Ready? He's chomping at the bit.
items.note: Hevesli bekleyişi anlatır; 'champing' da denir.

items.example: After two years in the same job, I'm getting itchy feet.
items.exampleTr: Aynı işte iki yıl sonra içimde gitme isteği başladı.
items.simple: You want to travel or change your life again.
dialogue: A: Another trip? You just got back!
B: I know, I've got itchy feet again.
items.note: Seyahat, taşınma veya iş değiştirme isteği için.

items.tr: moral bozucu bir şey, keyif kaçıran
items.example: The film was good, but the ending was a bit of a downer.
items.exampleTr: Film güzeldi ama sonu biraz moral bozucuydu.
items.simple: Something that makes you feel sad or less happy.
dialogue: A: They cancelled the barbecue because of rain.
B: That's a bit of a downer.
items.note: Kişi için de: 'Don't be such a downer' = keyfimizi kaçırma.

items.example: We were on tenterhooks waiting for the test results.
items.exampleTr: Test sonuçlarını diken üstünde bekledik.
items.simple: Nervous and excited while you wait to know something.
dialogue: A: Did you hear back about the flat?
B: Not yet. I've been on tenterhooks all day.
items.note: Sonuç, haber, karar beklerken.
